messages:
mike_partnerships: Quick sync — we should put together a short "playbook" for Datadog + OpenTelemetry tracing onboarding for partners. Deliverables: 1) dashboard template, 2) OTEL collector config snippet, 3) tracing tags standard, 4) marketplace listing checklist. Can we scope this in a week?

lisa_prod: +1. Happy to own the checklist + publish copy for marketplace. timeline: draft by Tue, final by Thu.

ajenkins_eng: I'll take the OTEL collector config and trace tags. Want to keep instrumentation minimal for early adopters (http status, latency_ms, model_id, request_source).

vera_sre: Also add a fallback sampling policy and costs note. Datadog traces can explode if sampling isn't set. Recommend default 1% with env override.

toni_sales: From GTM side we need a co-branded dashboard image and 1-2 example customer stories (short). I'll coordinate with Datadog PM for logos/approval.

mike_partnerships: Great. Quick checklist draft here: 
- instrumentation keys (http.method, route, status_code, latency_ms, model.variant, tenant_id)
- OTEL receiver + exporter snippet (we'll add below)
- Datadog dashboard JSON template
- Monitor recipes (error rate, tail latency, increased token cost per request)
- Rollout & announcement steps (private beta -> marketplace listing -> joint blog)

ajenkins_eng: OTEL snippet for envoy + collector (example):
```yaml
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      http:
      grpc:
exporters:
  datadog:
    api:
      key: ${DATADOG_API_KEY}
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      exporters: [datadog]
```
Notes: set Resource attributes: service.name=redwood-inference, deploy.env, model.name, model.version.

lisa_prod: Datadog dashboard template (mini) — feel free to adapt. We should include 3 panels: p50/p95 latency, errors per minute, traces per endpoint. Short JSON: 
```json
{"widgets":[{"title":"p95 latency","type":"timeseries"},{"title":"errors/min","type":"timeseries"},{"title":"traces by endpoint","type":"toplist"}]}
```
This is intentionally minimal so partners can import and tweak.

vera_sre: Monitoring rules suggestions: 
- alert if p95 > 1.5x baseline for 5m
- error rate > 0.5% for 10m
- sudden spike in traces ingestion (cost guardrail)
Also add runbook link: <https://confluence.redwood/inference/trace-runbook>

toni_sales: For marketplace listing we need:
- feature bullets (trace collection, dashboards, builtin monitors)
- pricing note (watch token ingestion costs)
- security & data flow diagram (OTEL -> collector -> datadog)
I'll draft copy after lisa's checklist.

mike_partnerships: Ops considerations: add a toggle in Console to enable/disable trace forwarding per workspace + key rotation instructions. ajenkins, can you add a small API flag?

ajenkins_eng: Yup — feature flag: trace_forwarding_enabled, and endpoint to set datadog_api_key per workspace. Will mock in dev env this week.

opsbot: [automation] Created task RED-3982: "Datadog OTEL onboarding playbook" assigned to mike_partnerships, ajenkins_eng, lisa_prod. Due 2026-02-13.

mike_partnerships: For the joint announcement cadence: private beta -> case studies -> marketplace beta -> joint blog + webinar. Propose we target marketplace listing in 4 weeks if dev + legal OK.

lisa_prod: I'll ping legal for co-marketing agreement. toni, can you get the Datadog PM contact?

toni_sales: DMing now. Also will ask for a small co-swag budget for the webinar.

vera_sre: One more ops note: make sure we include guidance on PII redaction in traces. Add example of dropping headers/body tokens before export.

ajenkins_eng: Example psuedo-filter (OTEL processor):
```yaml
processors:
  attributes:
    actions:
      - key: http.request.header.authorization
        action: delete
      - key: request_body.tokens
        action: delete
```
I'll include this in the repo.

mike_partnerships: Solid. Next steps: lisa to push checklist draft Tue, ajenkins to PR OTEL + API flag, vera to draft runbook additions, toni to coordinate Datadog comms. We'll reconvene Friday 11am for status. Anyone can't make it?

lisa_prod: Works for me.

vera_sre: In calendar.

ajenkins_eng: I'll be there.

opsbot: [reminder] Meeting: "Datadog OTEL onboarding — sync" Fri 11:00 AM (link added to calendar).

mike_partnerships: Thanks team :rocket: Let's keep the playbook as lightweight as possible for first partners and iterate.
